blocks.text: Why choose BIXAUN's car screen protector?

1. High-definition anti-glare material: MAXGUARD uses advanced high-definition matte material, combined with AG anti-glare coating technology, to provide clear vision while effectively reducing glare and reflection, ensuring comfortable use in all kinds of light.

2. Excellent durability: The use of high-quality tempered glass with 9H hardness, combined with 2.5D curved edge design, ensures a perfect fit on the screen, resists scratches and impacts, and provides long-term protection for your car screen.

3. Sensitive touch experience: MAXGUARD's screen protector uses the latest thermal sensing nanotechnology to ensure smooth finger touch without affecting the screen's response speed, allowing you to easily operate the navigation and control interface.

4. Intimate service: Our customer support team is on call 24 hours a day. Whether it is an installation problem or a product consultation, you can contact us at any time by email. We promise to respond within 30 hours and provide professional and considerate service guarantee.

items.label: High Sensitivity
items.value: Are you still worried about lag and false touches? This 2025 2026 Terrain navigation film uses advanced ultra-low latency nano-coating technology to maintain smooth touch even with wet hands or extreme weather, reducing lag and false touches, and improving driving safety and experience

items.label: HD Transparent
items.value: For 2025 2026 Terrain screen protector is made of optical-grade high-transparency material and is designed with 8K clear visibility to ensure true color reproduction, provide a more comfortable viewing experience, and will not cause eye fatigue even after long-term use

items.label: Military-Grade Protection
items.value: BIXUAN 2025 2026 Terrain 9H military-grade tempered glass screen protector, made of thermal nanotechnology, is only 0.28mm thick and 4 times harder than ordinary tempered glass, effectively preventing scratches, collisions and daily wear and tear, especially suitable for families with children or pets

items.label: Reduces Fingerprints and Smudges
items.value: Tired of fingerprints affecting your screen? BIXUAN touch screen protector use a special hydrophobic and oleophobic coating that, after multiple tests, will reduce fingerprints by up to 90%. No matter how you tap, swipe, your screen will stay looking like new

items.label: Easy to Install
items.value: BIXUAN 2025 2026 Terrain screen protector adopts 1:1 curved black edge electrostatic adsorption design, comes with detailed installation instructions and a scraper, easy to install at home without professional tools, ensuring that the film fits flat and without bubbles, achieving visual invisibility
